# Achari Murghi

## Ingredients

- ¼ cup mustard oil or canola oil
- 2 tablespoons Ginger Paste
- 1 tablespoon Garlic Paste
- 1 tablespoon black or yellow mustard seeds, ground
- 1½ teaspoons fenugreek seeds, ground
- 1½ teaspoons coarse kosher or sea salt
- 1 teaspoon cayenne (ground red pepper)
- ½ teaspoon ground turmeric
- 1 chicken (3½ pounds), skin removed, cut into 8 pieces
- 1½ pounds bottle gourd squash
- ¼ cup finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves and tender stems

## Instructions

1. Thoroughly combine the oil, Ginger Paste, Garlic Paste, mustard, fenugreek, salt, cayenne, and turmeric in a medium-size bowl.
2. Put the chicken pieces into the bowl and smear them well with the thick paste.
3. Refrigerate, covered, for at least 1 hour or even overnight, to allow the flavors to permeate the flesh.
4. Cut off and discard the stem and heel ends of the squash.
5. Peel the squash with a vegetable peeler, and then cut it in half lengthwise.
6. Scoop out the seeds and the surrounding spongy mass, using with a spoon or melon baller, to create two firm-fleshed, pale green, squash “boats.”
7. Cut the squash into 1-inch pieces, and set aside.
8. Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
9. Add the chicken pieces, marinade and all, meat side down, in a single layer.
10. Sear until the pieces are light brown, about 5 minutes.
11. Turn the pieces over and sear the other side, about 5 minutes.
12. Transfer the chicken to a plate.

## Notes

SERVES 6
